title: Alpine Light
summary: Cloud seas at sunrise, turquoise lakes and a long blue hour in the high country.
story:
The mountains do most of the work here. Light arrives from the side, catches one ridge at a time, and leaves the valleys in blue shadow.

These frames are arranged the way a day moves: sunrise above the cloud, midday on the lake, and the stars that come out once the last hut light goes off.
coverAlt: A small wooden rowboat on turquoise alpine water with limestone peaks behind

stops.note: Be up high before the light arrives. The valley fills with cloud and the peaks stand out of it.
stops.tip: Bring gloves: it is cold long after the sun is up.

stops.note: A clear, moonless night turns the ridge into a skyline of its own.
Rent a rowboat once the early crowd thins. The water is greenest when the sun is high.
stops.tip: Walk the shore path for the opposite view of the same boats.

stops.note: From the boat, the far shore does the composing for you.

title: Paper Lanterns
summary: Wooden lanes, red pagodas and the hour after dusk.
story: A collection built around evening: the moment shopfronts glow, lanterns come on and a mountain turns pink behind a pagoda.
coverAlt: A wooden-fronted lane at dusk with a pagoda in the distance and a woman in a kimono walking away

days.title: Kyoto, as the lights come on

stops.note: Wooden lanes, a pagoda at the end of the street, and the hour when shopfronts glow.
stops.tip: Go in the last hour before dark; the crowds thin and the sky stays blue.

stops.note: Climb the steps for the classic view: a red pagoda with the mountain standing over the town.

title: Subcontinent Days
summary: Marble at first light, then yellow cabs once the sun is gone.
coverAlt: The Taj Mahal at dawn, mirrored in a long reflecting pool lined with clipped cypresses

title: Island Temples
summary: Stone and water, mist and morning, from a lake in Bali to a hilltop in Java.
coverAlt: Bell-shaped stupas rising through morning haze at Borobudur

title: Weekend Escapes
summary: Short drives, long roads and places to switch off for two days.
story: Not every trip needs a passport. These are the quick ones: a van, a forest path, a waterfall and a ridge with the weather coming in.
coverAlt: A yellow camper van parked on a desert road beneath red sandstone cliffs
